note:
546 -> 541 (-5) on the ruff 0.15.19 -> 0.16.0 upgrade. Two independent causes:
(1) -1: RUF076 (pytest-fixture-autouse) was REMOVED upstream in ruff 0.15.20 as "highly opinionated" with no replacement code. 0.16.0 refuses to start on a config that selects it ("Rule RUF076 was removed and cannot be selected"), so the select entry had to go; its single finding goes with it.
(2) -4: the 546 floor was measured against a dirty working tree. Re-measuring the UNCHANGED config at clean HEAD with the pinned 0.15.19 gives 542, not 546. Pre-existing correction, not a regression from this upgrade.
The version bump itself is count-neutral: clean HEAD + the fixed config measures 541 on BOTH 0.15.19 and 0.16.0, and no other selected rule is removed or deprecated in 0.16.0.
Pin reconciled: requirements-dev.txt, .github/workflows/ruff.yml and .pre-commit-config.yaml now all say 0.16.0.
Command: ruff check odoo/ --no-cache --statistics | awk '{s+=$1} END {print s+0}'
